column3: MT 14:2. “On your iniquity” is rendered “because of your iniquity.”
MT 14:3. “Take good” is rendered “receive us graciously”; “let us pay bulls, our lips” is rendered “That we may present the fruit of our lips,” following a different division of the Hebrew.
MT 14:4. “By you the fatherless is shown compassion” is rendered “in You the orphan finds mercy.”
MT 14:5. “Voluntariness” is rendered “freely,” and “from him” “from them.”
MT 14:6. NASB supplies “the cedars of” before “Lebanon.”
MT 14:7. NASB supplies “the cedars of” before “Lebanon.”
MT 14:8. “Shade” is rendered “shadow,” and “memorial” “renown”; NASB adds “again.”
MT 14:9. “What to me again to idols” is rendered “what more have I to do with idols?”; “watch over it” is rendered “look after you.”
MT 14:10. “Who is wise and let him understand” is rendered “Whoever is wise, let him understand.”
